{{Top|leg}}
The '''Room of Change''' was a room that was located inside the [[Temple of Pain]], a [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]] situated within the [[Tascollan Nebula/Legends|Tascollan Nebula]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Thaum Rystra]] utilized the room as a laboratory, using [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] to carry out experiments on prisoners.
